Scenario assumptions — not field validation
SYNTHETIC INPUTS USED HERE — The Period Components export does not provide channel units/locations or air temperature. Channel groups below are unverified scenario assignments and irradiance is interpreted as W/m². Temperature-dependent outputs use supplemental typical-year air temperature, not measured temperatures from the irradiance year; crop-cycle fresh-mass equivalents also use an assumed 5% dry-matter fraction. Unrecorded irradiance timestamps are assumed to have zero light. Crop biomass values are uncalibrated model-derived scenario estimates, not validated yields: the growth equation, channel units, and dry-matter conversion are not calibrated for this site. The GDD clock makes cool-season cycles longer while the separate biomass equation accumulates throughout each cycle. The final cycle may be incomplete. These are scenario outputs, not observed harvests or independent field validation. In this run the pipeline temperature input was TMY climatological air temperature from tmy_air_temperature.csv, UTC month/day/hour mapped to local standard-time hours (23.8°C), and the crop-cycle calculations use the same series. Modeled crop-cycle estimates (uncalibrated)

Fresh-mass equivalent = modeled dry-mass gain divided by the assumed 5% dry-matter fraction. The GDD clock sets cycle duration and the separate biomass model accumulates throughout the cycle. The per-plant conversion uses the configured 96 plants over 11.25 m². For context only, values are compared with the user-reported 100–300 g/plant range; those records are not currently available for calibration. These are not measured or validated harvests.
